title: ERC-3643 Tokenised RWA Freeze & Unverified Recipient Blind Spot
common_agent_failure: Agent inspects only standard ERC-20 balanceOf() and assumes a tokenised treasury or bond transfer will settle, ignoring ERC-3643 partial token freezes and ONCHAINID recipient eligibility checks that revert onchain or violate issuer transfer rules.
required_unknowns_preserved: Onchain ERC-3643 selectors do not establish off-chain issuer solvency, custody backing, legal redemption rights, or jurisdictional licensing.
